browser.unsortedHint: Large branch: entries are listed in server order, not sorted. Use search to find a specific entry.
browser.selectEntry: Select an entry in the tree

edit.conflict: The entry was changed by someone else since you opened it. Reload it and repeat your changes.
edit.notAllowed: Not allowed by the object classes; remove it or add a class that permits it

delete.title: Delete entry
delete.subtree: Also delete all {n} entries below it | Also delete all {n} entries below it
delete.hasChildren: This entry has child entries. Without the option below the server will refuse to delete it.

rename.title: Rename or move
rename.deleteOldRdn: Remove the old RDN value from the entry

password.title: Set password
password.generate: Let the server generate a password

create.title: New entry under {parent}
create.chooseTemplate: What do you want to create?
create.rdnRequired: Enter a value for the naming attribute {attr}
create.classesRequired: Choose at least one structural object class

posix-user.title: POSIX user
posix-user.description: User with UID, home directory and shell (inetOrgPerson + posixAccount)

group.title: Group
group.description: Group of entries referenced by DN (groupOfNames)

posix-group.title: POSIX group
posix-group.description: Group with a GID number (groupOfNames + posixGroup)

custom.title: Custom entry
custom.description: Choose object classes and attributes yourself

search.title: Search
search.attrsHint: Comma-separated; empty shows all user attributes
search.truncated: Only the first {n} entries are shown. Narrow the filter or raise the limit.
search.csvNeedsAttrs: CSV export needs an attribute list
search.quickPlaceholder: Name, uid or email — or an LDAP filter such as (mail=*{'@'}example.com)

ldif.passwordNote: Password attributes are not exported; they are kept unless you add them.
ldif.importHint: Entries (added) and change records with changetype add, modify or delete. modrdn and URL values (attr:< …) are not supported.

groups.addPlaceholder: Find users or groups by name, uid or email…
groups.memberOfNone: Not a member of any group
groups.memberOfHint: Groups that list this entry as member or uniqueMember

monitor.title: Monitoring

charts.collecting: Collecting data… the first points appear after a few seconds; history is kept for one hour while ds-ui runs.

monitor.cacheWarning: Low hit ratio with a full cache: the cache is probably too small for the working set (nsslapd-cachememsize).
monitor.restartConfirm: Restart the directory server? Clients are disconnected for a few seconds.
monitor.restartRequired: Some changes take effect only after a restart: {reasons}

db.title: Databases
db.name: Backend name
db.readOnlyHint: Reject all write operations to this suffix
db.requireIndexHint: Reject searches that cannot use an index
db.rootMissing: The root entry {suffix} does not exist yet.
db.dangerText: Deletes the backend and ALL entries under {suffix}. This cannot be undone.
db.dangerShort: Removes the backend and all its entries for good.

indexes.added: Index on {attr} added. Reindex to build it.
indexes.updated: Index updated. Reindex to apply it.
indexes.defaultHint: A suffix created later starts with these indexes. Existing suffixes are not changed.

backups.name: Name
backups.restoreConfirm: Restore ALL databases from {name}? Changes made after this backup are lost and the databases are offline while restoring.
backups.noFiles: Backups can be created, but listing, downloading and deleting them needs access to the server's files (sidecar or all-in-one mode).
backups.sensitive: Backups contain the server configuration including TLS private keys (config_files). Keep downloaded archives as secrets.

ldifFiles.noFiles: LDIF files on the server need access to its files (sidecar or all-in-one mode). For small amounts of data use the LDIF import/export of the LDAP browser.

transfer.exportHint: Writes the whole suffix to a file in the server's LDIF directory (an online task).
transfer.replication: Include replication state (to initialise a replica)
transfer.importHint: Replaces ALL entries of this suffix with the content of the file.
transfer.chooseFile: Choose a file from the LDIF directory
transfer.importWarning: All entries of {suffix} will be replaced with the content of {file}.

logs.title: Logs
logs.filterHint: Words that must all occur, e.g. conn=12 or err=32 or BIND
logs.disabled: This log is disabled on the server
logs.truncated: Only the last 64 MB of the file were searched
logs.buffered: The access log is buffered: new lines appear in batches.
logs.sameAs: Written to the same file as the {other} log
logs.noFiles: Logs need access to the server's files (sidecar or all-in-one mode).
logs.clickHint: Click a line to show every line of its connection

ldap.unwillingToPerform: The server is unwilling to perform the operation

pages._restartHint: Takes effect after the server is restarted.
pages._dangerHint: A wrong value can cut ds-ui off from the server.
pages._dangerConfirm: You are changing: {fields}. A wrong value can make the server unreachable for ds-ui; fixing it then needs shell access to the container.
pages._savedRestart: Saved. {n} setting takes effect after a restart. | Saved. {n} settings take effect after a restart.

mode.label: File permissions
mode.help: Octal mode of new log files, e.g. 600.

buffering.label: Buffered writes
buffering.help: Faster, but the last lines may appear with a delay.

hideUnhashedPw.label: Hide clear-text passwords
hideUnhashedPw.help: Do not write the unhashed userPassword of changes.

maxlogsperdir.label: Files to keep
maxlogsperdir.help: Maximum number of log files, including the active one.

rotationtime.label: Rotate every
rotationtime.help: Together with the unit below; -1 disables rotation by time.

expirationtime.label: Delete files older than
expirationtime.help: Together with the unit below; -1 keeps them.

maxdiskspace.label: Total size limit
maxdiskspace.help: Oldest files are deleted above this; -1 disables.

minfreediskspace.label: Keep free disk space
minfreediskspace.help: Oldest files are deleted when free space falls below this.

passwordMustChange.label: Change after reset
passwordMustChange.help: Users must change a password set by an administrator.

passwordMinAge.label: Minimum age
passwordMinAge.help: Before the password can be changed again.

passwordAdminDN.label: Password administrators
passwordAdminDN.help: Entry or group that may bypass the policy.

passwordCheckSyntax.label: Check syntax
passwordCheckSyntax.help: Enforce the requirements in this group.

passwordMinCategories.label: Character categories
passwordMinCategories.help: Of digits, upper, lower, special and 8-bit.

passwordMinTokenLength.label: Token length
passwordMinTokenLength.help: Parts of the user's attributes this long must not appear.

passwordMaxSequence.label: Max sequence length
passwordMaxSequence.help: Like abcd or 1234; 0 does not check.

passwordDictPath.label: Dictionary path
passwordDictPath.help: Empty uses the system cracklib dictionary.

passwordUserAttributes.label: Check against attributes
passwordUserAttributes.help: Space-separated attributes of the user that must not appear.

passwordUnlock.label: Unlock automatically
passwordUnlock.help: Otherwise an administrator must reset the password.

nsslapd-localhost.label: Host name
nsslapd-localhost.help: Used in referrals and generated URLs.

nsslapd-port.label: LDAP port
nsslapd-port.help: 0 disables plain LDAP. Inside the container ports are mapped by Docker.

nsslapd-readonly.label: Read-only server
nsslapd-readonly.help: Rejects all writes, including to cn=config.

nsslapd-syntaxcheck.label: Syntax checking
nsslapd-syntaxcheck.help: Rejects values that do not match the attribute syntax.

nsslapd-entryusn-global.label: Global entry USN
nsslapd-entryusn-global.help: One USN counter for all backends.

nsslapd-ignore-virtual-attrs.label: Ignore virtual attributes
nsslapd-ignore-virtual-attrs.help: Faster searches; disable if you use CoS or roles in filters.

nsslapd-return-exact-case.label: Return attribute names as in schema

nsslapd-dynamic-plugins.label: Dynamic plug-ins
nsslapd-dynamic-plugins.help: Plug-in changes take effect without a restart.

server-limits.title: Limits and performance
server-limits.description: Defaults for all clients; users can have their own limits.

nsslapd-sizelimit.label: Size limit
nsslapd-sizelimit.help: Entries returned per search; -1 is unlimited.

nsslapd-ioblocktimeout.label: I/O block timeout
nsslapd-ioblocktimeout.help: A connection blocked this long is closed.

disk-monitoring.title: Disk monitoring
disk-monitoring.description: Protects the database when the disk fills up: logs are cut down, then the server stops.

nsslapd-disk-monitoring-grace-period.label: Grace period
nsslapd-disk-monitoring-grace-period.help: Time before the server shuts down once below half the threshold.

nsslapd-disk-monitoring-logging-critical.label: Keep logging
nsslapd-disk-monitoring-logging-critical.help: Do not disable access logging when low on space.

db-global.title: Global database settings
db-global.description: Apply to every backend. Per-backend cache sizes are on the Databases page.

nsslapd-lookthroughlimit.label: Look-through limit
nsslapd-lookthroughlimit.help: Candidate entries examined per search; -1 is unlimited.

nsslapd-idlistscanlimit.label: ID list scan limit
nsslapd-idlistscanlimit.help: Above this an index is treated as unindexed (allids).

nsslapd-backend-implement.label: Database implementation
nsslapd-backend-implement.help: Changing it requires exporting and re-importing all data.

db-mdb.title: LMDB
db-mdb.description: Settings of the LMDB database environment shared by all backends.

nsslapd-mdb-max-size.label: Maximum database size
nsslapd-mdb-max-size.help: The memory map size: the database cannot grow beyond it.

nsslapd-mdb-max-readers.label: Maximum readers
nsslapd-mdb-max-readers.help: 0 sizes automatically from the thread count.

nsslapd-mdb-max-dbs.label: Maximum databases
nsslapd-mdb-max-dbs.help: One per index and backend; raise it for many indexes.

nsslapd-db-durable-transaction.label: Durable transactions
nsslapd-db-durable-transaction.help: Sync to disk on every commit: safer, slower.

nsslapd-errorlog-level.label: Level
nsslapd-errorlog-level.help: Debug bits are very verbose; turn them off after troubleshooting.

log-audit.title: Audit log
log-audit.description: Records every change made to the directory.

nsslapd-auditlog-display-attrs.label: Extra attributes
nsslapd-auditlog-display-attrs.help: Attributes of the changed entry to add to each record, e.g. cn; * for all.

log-auditfail.title: Audit failures
log-auditfail.description: Records changes that the server rejected.

log-security.title: Security log
log-security.description: Binds, authorization failures and TCP-level events.

nsslapd-anonlimitsdn.label: Limits for anonymous
nsslapd-anonlimitsdn.help: Entry whose resource limits apply to anonymous clients.

nsslapd-require-secure-binds.label: Require secure binds
nsslapd-require-secure-binds.help: Simple binds only over TLS or LDAPI.

nsslapd-minssf.label: Minimum SSF
nsslapd-minssf.help: Operations on weaker connections are refused; 0 allows plain LDAP.

nsslapd-allowed-sasl-mechanisms.label: Allowed SASL mechanisms
nsslapd-allowed-sasl-mechanisms.help: Comma-separated; empty allows all. EXTERNAL is always allowed.

ldapi.title: LDAPI
ldapi.description: LDAP over a Unix socket. In the sidecar deployment ds-ui itself connects this way as Directory Manager.

nsslapd-ldapiautobind.label: Autobind
nsslapd-ldapiautobind.help: Bind as the local user that opened the socket.

nsslapd-ldapimaprootdn.label: Root maps to
nsslapd-ldapimaprootdn.help: The DN that the system user root (and the server user) binds as.

password-policy.title: Global password policy
password-policy.description: Applies to all users unless a subtree or user policy overrides it.

password-policy-local.title: Subtree or user policy
password-policy-local.description: A local password policy. Attributes that are not set take the server defaults, not the values of the global policy.

plugin-referint.title: Referential Integrity
plugin-referint.description: Updates or removes references (member, owner, …) when the referenced entry is renamed or deleted.

referint-membership-attr.label: Reference attributes
referint-membership-attr.help: Must be indexed for equality in every backend.

referint-update-delay.label: Update delay
referint-update-delay.help: 0 updates synchronously; a delay batches updates in the background.

referint-logfile.label: Work file
referint-logfile.help: Pending changes when a delay is set.

nsslapd-pluginContainerScope.label: References only from
nsslapd-pluginContainerScope.help: Only fix references held by entries in these subtrees.

plugin-memberof.title: MemberOf
plugin-memberof.description: Maintains memberOf in user entries from the member attributes of groups.

memberOfAllBackends.label: Across all backends
memberOfAllBackends.help: Groups and members may be in different suffixes.

memberOfSkipNested.label: Skip nested groups
memberOfSkipNested.help: Faster when groups are not nested.

memberOfAutoAddOC.label: Object class to add
memberOfAutoAddOC.help: Added to members that do not allow memberOf.

plugin-uniqueness.title: Attribute Uniqueness
plugin-uniqueness.description: Rejects changes that would give two entries the same value of an attribute (the default uid instance).

uniqueness-across-all-subtrees.label: Unique across all subtrees
uniqueness-across-all-subtrees.help: Otherwise each subtree is checked on its own.

uniqueness-top-entry-oc.label: Top entry class
uniqueness-top-entry-oc.help: Instead of subtrees: unique below entries of this class.

plugin-rootdn.title: Root DN Access Control
plugin-rootdn.description: Limits when and from where Directory Manager may bind. ds-ui itself works as Directory Manager.

rootdn-days-allowed.label: Days
rootdn-days-allowed.help: e.g. Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri

plugin-retrocl.title: Retro Changelog
plugin-retrocl.description: Records changes in cn=changelog for applications that poll for them.

nsslapd-attribute.label: Extra attributes
nsslapd-attribute.help: attribute[:alias] recorded with each change, e.g. nsUniqueId:targetUniqueId

plugin-account-policy.title: Account Policy
plugin-account-policy.description: Records logins and locks out accounts that have been inactive for too long.

alwaysRecordLogin.label: Record every login
alwaysRecordLogin.help: Otherwise only for accounts with a policy.

sasl-mappings.title: SASL mappings
sasl-mappings.description: How a SASL identity (e.g. a Kerberos principal) is mapped to an entry. Mappings are tried by priority; groups of the regular expression (\1, \2) are substituted into the templates.

root-password.title: Directory Manager password
root-password.description: The password of the root DN. The server stores it hashed with the Directory Manager scheme of the password policy.

plugins.protected: Required by the server; cannot be disabled here.
plugins.notDynamic: Dynamic plug-ins are off: enabling, disabling and reconfiguring plug-ins takes effect after a server restart.
plugins.disabledHint: The plug-in is disabled: its settings are kept but have no effect.

rootPassword.confirmSimple: ds-ui connects to the server with a password. If it binds as Directory Manager, it switches to the new password now, but after its own restart it reads the old one from its secret file again.
rootPassword.secretText: ds-ui uses the new password until it restarts. Put it into the file named by

sasl.name: Name
sasl.regexHint: Matched against the SASL identity; parenthesised groups become \1, \2, …
sasl.priorityHint: 1 is tried first, 100 last; 0 leaves it unset (100).

vlv.buildHint: A new VLV index is built right after it is created. Indexing works on the live database: on a large suffix, make a backup first.
vlv.deleteConfirm: Delete the VLV index “{name}” and its sort orders?
vlv.sortHint: One sort order per line: attributes separated by spaces, -attr for descending.

schemaView.name: Name
schemaView.pick: Select a definition in the list
schemaView.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}” from the schema? This is possible only while nothing uses it.
schemaView.namesHint: The first name is the main one; letters, digits and hyphens.
schemaView.oidHint: A numeric OID under your organisation's arc, or name-oid for local use.
schemaView.kindHint: Auxiliary classes are added to existing entries; structural ones define an entry.

policies.subtreeHint: Every entry below gets this policy (through Class of Service).
policies.userHint: Only this entry gets the policy.
policies.created: Policy for {target} created. Unset settings take the server defaults.
policies.localTurnedOn: Local policies were off in the server settings; they are on now.
policies.localOff: Local policies are off in the server settings: the policies below are ignored.
policies.deleteSubtree: Delete the policy of {target}? Entries below go back to the global policy.
policies.deleteUser: Delete the policy of {target}? The user goes back to the subtree or global policy.
